name: Hera TV
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
overview: The Apple TV app's look for Jellyfin's web client

versions.changelog: A title's meta line is tidier: the certificate reads as the board writes it (15, not GB-15) in its own outlined badge between the line's dots, Rotten Tomatoes scores carry the tomato or splat and the popcorn bucket instead of boxed labels and thumbs, and the scores sit in the line's own grey. A post-play trailer starts at half volume, scaled to the player's own volume.

The volume popup (the wheel or a volume key in the player) is a glass capsule with a white level, like the rest of the player. In post-play the wheel turns the trailer up and down with the same popup, the trailer's sound control is drawn like the player's own, and the trailer plays once: when it ends, the film's artwork takes the screen.

Post-play fixes: Play and Play Next Episode now start the next title (by the server's PlayNow, which also stopped working after a server restart until the page was reloaded). A film's trailer now plays with sound as the credits' music fades out, with mute and volume at the lower right, and after 30 seconds the credits leave the screen. A back arrow at the top left leaves the player.

Post-play: at the credits the picture shrinks into the corner and the next episode, or the next film in its collection with its trailer, takes the screen. Skip Intro rises above the controls. Discover gets a header row with search and Requests, a feature that takes turns through what's trending, request states from the download stack (Awaiting Release, not Processing) and a 1080p / 4K choice when requesting. Card menus match across rows; the stray line under Up Next's menu button is gone.

Every sideways row (Hera's and Jellyfin's: Recently Added, Episodes, Cast & Crew, More Like This) gets tv.apple.com's hover paddles to scroll it with a mouse. A collection's own page wraps its films into a grid; Up Next cards keep one menu button (Open Page lives in it); services shown by app icon drop the name under it; the JustWatch credit under Also On is a small grey caption; button rows on other plugins' pages sit centred.
